To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of CASE environments can provide the means to improve the reliability of information and software system development.

the use of formal development methods and tools in CASE environments provides the following opportunities for reliability engineering: (1) to assess the reliability requirements and the design of the system before the development begins; (2) to assess the system against its design after it is developed; (3) to maintain the description of the system and the design of it as accurate documentation; and (4) to use the design to assess the reliability after the system has been implemented.
the use of CASE environments makes it practical to apply formal system-development methods and that this practice can improve the reliability of information-system development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of formal methods to develop and maintain reliable information systems.
the use of formal methods of information systems development to improve the reliability of information and software.
the development of methods, models, and tools for the reliability analysis of information systems and software.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
formal methods of information systems development are not widely used in practice because of the lack of appropriate tools.
the use of formal methods and CASE environments can be used to design and develop reliable information systems.
the CASE environments are not only a practical and economical way to develop reliable information systems but that they provide a powerful tool to analyze and audit the reliability of a system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CASE environment can be a very useful tool for reliability engineers.
we have developed a formal approach to reliability engineering for information and software systems.
the CASE tools and environments provide a practical and economical means to use formal methods for the development of information systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
formal methods can be used to develop reliable systems, and that CASE can be used to automate the formal methods.
the reliability of an information system can be assessed by using the CASE environment as a tool.
CASE tools can provide the basis for a new approach to information system reliability assessment and management.
